prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone body illustration for 德州扒鸡制作技艺, Dezhou braised-chicken craft; cultural food-table art, not a menu, recipe, advertisement or city hero.

Create ONE original colour-woodcut and opaque-gouache-style illustration of a quiet Chinese meal. A compact cooked whole braised chicken with tucked limbs sits fully within a simple dark oval serving plate, seen from a slightly overhead angle. Show warm golden-brown food with cream cut-line highlights, broad umber shadows and stylised carved-grain marks. Food is clearly cooked, non-graphic, not a raw carcass or western turkey. A couple of plain small bowls and one pair of simple chopsticks suggest the tabletop nearby, without people.

Make this decisively different from watery ink: confident flat colour blocks, dry gouache surfaces, rough woodcut-like edge texture and warm table geometry. Use muted brick/vermilion red, dark warm charcoal, wheat gold and cream, with a tiny subdued jade accent if useful. The table is an imagined domestic arrangement, not a restaurant's recognisable set, a famous painting, historical reconstruction, branded product photo or exact standard plating. No copied logo, decorative mark or advertising packaging. No gilt luxury frame or glossy food render.

ONE complete native horizontal3:2 artwork, ideally1536×1024. Keep the plate and essential meal objects fully inset in a central compact group, roughly within the middle46% of width and middle60% of height, with generous simple coloured margins. Slightly overhead, graphic and angular table organisation, not an oblique white-paper product still life. Mobile should preferably show the complete artwork without forced cropping.
No recipe stages, kitchen equipment in use, flames, ingredient chart, quantities, temperatures, nutrition, health or food-safety claims. AI creative interpretation only, not actual craft evidence or identified pottery.
Absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, calligraphy, signature, seals, shop sign, prices, logos, watermark, pseudo-writing, borders, device frames, UI or multiple panels.
timePrecision: 原记录时间及偏移原样保留；本轮复制不是重新生成
